newsitem.title: MEXICO: Mexican daily port, shipping update for March 31.
newsitem.headline: Mexican daily port, shipping update for March 31.

text.p: All Mexican ports were open to larger ships on Monday, the Communications and Transport Ministry (SCT) said in its 1000 local/1600 GMT daily meteorological report.
A cold front in the northern region of the Gulf of Mexico closed Tampico, Veracruz, Tuxpan, Coatzacoalcos, Alvarado and Nautla ports to smaller fishing and tourism craft.
Strong wind speeds and wave heights expected to move down the coast toward the Campeche Sound in the course of the day.

Cloudy with disperse rains along the coasts of Baja California, Sinaloa, Sonora, Nayarit and Jalisco states. Maximum winds in the region from 10 to 15 knots (19 to 28 km/11 to 16 miles per hour) with waves three to seven feet high.
A cold front in northern Veracruz bringing rains and strong winds to the region with winds clocked at 15 to 20 knots (28 to 38 km/16 to 22 miles per hour) and waves at nine to 12 feet high.
Hot and scattered clouds with winds from 20 to 30 km per hour.
